analysis.title: 10/30 Mkt Internal Insight: Excess & Retail Flow + Systematic Rebalance Intraday Update
key_insights: Excess sell flow bottomed at 10:30am. UBS RMM (retail) flow turned to buying slightly after, at 10:45am.
Estimated systematic selling for the day as of 11:30am: leveraged ETPs $26 bn, risk control funds $65-100 bn of which $20-25 bn today. The estimate will change with market moves.
CTA funds already crossed 3 sell triggers each in ES1 and NQ1.
Excess flow was -$17 bn in the S&P 500, while Nasdaq flow reversed to roughly -$0 bn excess flow.
Selling is concentrated in AI Semis (-5.8%), AI Software (-5.0%) and Profitless Tech (-4.7%) for a second day in a row.
UBS RMM clients sold in the first hour, typically WM clients reacting to prior-day and overnight weakness. Since 10:45am flow has been buying in every 5-minute interval.
UBS RMM net flow percentile (vs 3Y) rose from 14% at 10:40am to 30% at 11:20am. It is still a small net sell on the day but improving.

RMM buy tilt: ETFs (QQQ and SOX plus their leveraged ETFs), Consumer Discretionary, Banks and Broadline Retail. Sell tilt: Tech (Semis, Software and Services), Health Care (Biotech), Consumer Staples (HH Prods) and Energy (Oil and Gas).

Risk control scenario estimates scale with the index move: -1% means $15-25 bn to sell, -1.5% means $65-100 bn, -2% means $135-180 bn, -2.5% means $200-280 bn. Most of the sale falls tomorrow in each case.
CTA positioning differs by index: ES1 exposure at the 48th percentile vs 3Y, NQ1 at the 15th, RTY1 at the 16th. RTY1 had no sell triggers crossed this morning.
Risk parity shows no sign of unwinds. Nine assets are down but all treasuries are up.
Leveraged ETPs are estimated to sell $26 bn as of 10:30am, of which $24 bn is in QQQ and Tech. Semis account for $13.2 bn of that.
risk_factors: Further index declines would force larger risk control selling, concentrated the next day, per the scenario table.
Additional CTA sell triggers sit close to the market in ES1 (7647.5, 7581.3, 7556.5) and NQ1 (28441, 28036).
Leveraged ETP rebalancing selling is concentrated in semiconductors, including names where it reaches 24-50% of average daily volume.
vol_and_positioning: Risk control funds are estimated to sell $65-100 bn in total, of which $20-25 bn today (estimate as of 11:30am).
Leveraged ETPs are estimated to sell $26 bn as of 10:30am, $24 bn of it in QQQ and Tech.
CTA ES1 exposure sits at the 48th percentile vs 3Y with 3 sell triggers crossed pre-open and at 9:32am. The next three are 7647.5 (LT -0.2%), 7581.3 (MT -1.0%) and 7556.5 (ST -1.3%).

CTA NQ1 exposure sits at the 15th percentile vs 3Y with 3 sell triggers crossed pre-open. The next triggers are 28441 (MT -1.1%) and 28036 (LT and ST -2.5%), with a moving-average crossover within 5 days.
CTA RTY1 exposure sits at the 16th percentile vs 3Y with 0 sell triggers crossed this morning. The next trigger is 2806.1 (ST -1.3%).
Risk parity shows no unwind signal because treasuries are rising while 9 assets fall.
